description: Collection, treatment and disposal of waste. Includes street cleaning and the collection, treatment and disposal of all waste, whether by physical, biological or thermal processes; operation and supervision of recycling facilities; transport of waste.
includes: collection, treatment and disposal of waste
operation or support of waste collection, treatment and disposal systems
street cleaning, including snow removal where this is part of waste management
operation or support of recycling facilities
excludes: remediation activities of contaminated land, see 0530
